originalRequest:
Implement a materially distinct full-stack Signal Breach "Persistent tactical annotations on the live mission board" feature in THIS fresh physical copy only. All application code/tests/corrections authored by the local mtplx/mtplx-flash-next-optimized-speed model only (no delegation/fallback). Codex supplies requirements/review/harness. Continuation OFF. Preserve /srv/signal-breach and protected run lr-00000000e5f6; do not touch expired presets lr-000000001a2b or replay lr-000000003c4d.

FEATURE: A planner (planning/notes) mode on the real Three.js board. Player enters planning mode, selects a currently-visible board tile (vis==2), adds a short note (category danger|objective|route, text 1..120), inspects/edits/removes saved notes, exits planning to resume the unchanged game. Notes persist via a versioned HTTP API (/api/annotations/v1) into file-backed SQLite, keyed by exact mission index (0..2) and uint32 seed (0..4294967295, including ZERO). Show only notes for the current mission/seed. Existing campaign/saves/leaderboard/replay/AI-preview stay intact. No cloud/account, no simulation-rule/PRNG change, no Godot.

ACCEPTANCE A (server/data): server-generated stable note ID; validate mission 0..2, seed 0..4294967295 integer, tile x/y integers 0..13, category in set, trimmed text 1..120, bounded body + bounded per-(mission,seed) collection; optimistic revision; reject wall/out-of-board using the ACTUAL mission layout (wall/pillar) and do NOT clamp invalid mission/seed/coords; 400 invalid input, 404 unknown valid ID, 409 stale revision update/delete, 500 genuine storage failure. Parameterized SQLite only; failed writes leave data unchanged; server never trusts a client-chosen ID/revision. Schema init idempotent on a pre-feature DB and preserves complete leaderboard row values. Prove exact persistence across reload + a separate owned server restart on the SAME temp file DB and SAME port (ID, mission, seed0, coords, category, text, revision).

ACCEPTANCE B (gameplay): planning mode has visible state + clear exit; pointer/keyboard note interactions must not move/shoot/select a tactical unit, advance turn/revision, consume AP, mutate save/PRNG or append replay actions; ordinary tactical controls work after exit; use existing read-only current state/notifications (not polling/fake); test state hash/revision/AP/PRNG/replay invariance around note ops + real gameplay after; render readable markers anchored to correct tile at gameplay scale/camera; panel supplements markers, not replaces; only currently-visible tiles (vis=2) interactive/rendered on board; restoring visibility re-reveals the same note without sim mutation; no hidden enemy info in notes UI; observe real transitions, not a test-only shim.

ACCEPTANCE C (UI/resilience/a11y): loading/empty/validation/conflict/network/storage/success states; preserve unsaved text after failed writes; honest retry/reload; two independently loaded pages demonstrate stale-update/no-lost-update + recovery; guard late responses when mission/seed/selection change; pending write must not clear another draft; changing mission/leaving/disposal must not attach stale markers, keep listeners/resources alive, or apply responses to a departed world; delete needs confirmation, Cancel nondestructive; labels + accessible announcements + real keyboard traversal/focus (after editor open, Cancel, delete, planning off, back to tactical); render user text as text; repeated planning toggle/mission mount/unmount must not accumulate markers/handlers; record runtime observations.

ACCEPTANCE D (verification): exercise UI->real HTTP->file SQLite, exact values after reload/restart, validation/no-mutation/error, concurrency, pointer+keyboard, fog visibility, simulation invariance; preserve all existing default browser membership (34 tests in 12 files) and existing sim/server assertions (do not delete/skip/weaken for a count); reproducible browser screenshots (ordinary board, note editor, marker/category readability, fog, focus/error) with real inspection not just existence; keep actual command output of failures/repairs.

ACCEPTANCE E (negative control): after reviewed normal checks, Codex copies final reviewed source/deps to an independent fixture; I alone introduce ONE deliberate persistence/concurrency defect there; unchanged eligible native assertions must FAIL for that exact defect (not timeout/setup/launch/zero-tests/nonzero-exit). Do not change healthy source or weaken tests for the negative control; no shell-tool workaround copy.

MAPPING (fixed, do not change): annotations-server -> c-annotations-server (INTEGRATION); annotations-gameplay -> c-annotations-e2e (BROWSER); regression-unit -> c-default-unit (UNIT); regression-browser -> c-default-browser (BROWSER). Hard gates c-typecheck, c-build. New browser specs in ./e2e-annotations with playwright.annotations.config.ts (isolated file DB, owned loopback web 5499/server 9099, strictPort, reuseExistingServer false, Vite proxy to 9099).
